answer:
The tallest Ferris wheel in the world is the **Ain Dubai** (formerly known as The View at The Palm), located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It was completed and officially opened in **October 2021**. 

Standing at over 800 feet tall (specifically around 250 meters or approximately 820 feet), it surpassed the previous record holder, the High Roller in Las Vegas, which stood at 550 feet and was completed in 2014.
